title: Delta Flight Museum

services.name: Airbus Immersive VR Experience
services.desc: Step into the future of flight at the Delta Flight Museum. First introduced at CES 2025 and developed by Delta’s Global Innovation Center, The Hangar, the VR A320 Landing Experience brings cutting-edge aviation technology straight to the Museum floor. It’s a fun, immersive way to see how Delta is exploring new tools that could shape the future of pilot training. Climb into a life-sized Airbus A320 flight deck and try an abridged landing sequence using real pilot-style gestures and voice commands.
